contract: The rendering unit configures one GFM parser/HTML renderer pair and reuses it across distinct whole documents, with fresh document context, AST and output buffers. The public unit has 10,392 documents (116,306,743 bytes); the family-disjoint held-out unit has 12,581 documents (122,436,684 bytes). Each input is processed exactly once, without repetition or padding. Superseded changelog revisions, normalized duplicates and documents without commit provenance are excluded; no source exceeds about half of a unit's bytes. The library, extensions and options, driver, declared output comparator and one-second minimum unit duration are fixed. The parse-only unit configures one parser with auto heading IDs, GFM and footnotes and emits per-document heading, link, image, autolink, fenced-code and footnote records from an AST walk over the same documents, without rendering; outputs are exact. See tests/README.md for public reproduction.
description: Render 10,392 distinct complete public Markdown documents (116,306,743 bytes) to HTML once each, reusing one configured GFM parser/HTML renderer per unit, with exact per-document outputs. A second parse-only unit parses the same documents (heading IDs, GFM, footnotes) and walks the AST without rendering.
